payload.summary: Token-free Git push is drafted; GH_TOKEN environment migration and workflow acceptance remain
payload.detail: LOCAL IMPLEMENTATION 24 October 2026: ranking-snapshot-refresh.yml now uses gh auth setup-git and an explicit https://github.com/${REPOSITORY}.git push URL without credentials. Workflow contract test passes. Remaining: specifically approve and execute moving GH_TOKEN from repository secrets to the main-only production-secrets environment, couple both consuming jobs to that environment, verify branch protections and a real authorized run. Environment references are not enabled ahead of secret availability because that would break the controller; no credential or GitHub setting was changed.
